notes:
Account summary: existing Redwood Hosted customer since 2024-03. Primary product currently: hosted API for embeddings + chat. Looking to move critical reranking and session-based chat flows to Dedicated to meet 95th pct latency targets and predictable throughput for peak routing windows. Interest in Redwood Optimize to reduce token costs and get batching/quantization recommendations for their long-document reranker. Also requesting pilot for APAC region capacity and EU data residency for customers in regulated markets.

Key quotes: 'We need predictable SLA during peak cutover windows' — CTO (R. Nakamura); 'Cost delta needs to be justified by operations ROI' — Head of Platform (A. Singh).

Security: completed SOC2 questionnaire, need per-route audit logs and KMS integration (customer uses Azure Key Vault). Compliance team flagged data residency clause for EU/UK and want explicit audit trail for model versions.

Technical constraints: session length average 512 tokens but spikes up to 4096 for agent handoffs; typical qps 40 steady, 600 burst windows. Models: prefer open models (Llama-3 variants) but want Redwood-verified latency profile; fallback policy must route to cheaper quantized variant during capacity constraints.

Commercials & renewal: current contract renewal in May 2026. AE/Jordan running renewal + expansion as single SOW: base renewal + Dedicated reserved pool + Optimize onboarding + APAC region add-on. Procurement prefers single PO for all items. Est. ARR band 150k-350k depending on Dedicated sizing.

POC & milestones: see timeline.

CRM-style quick notes: shorthanded action items — ae: finalize SOW draft, se: run Dedicated perf sim w/ 4k tokens, csm: prepare onboarding plan for Optimize, legal: provide addendum for data residency.
